# Software Engineer - AI/ML

Noida, IND

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Family: Research & Development

Req ID: 530396

[Apply Now](https://rr.jobsyn.org/14339DE080E142818B9A0CA9A07198A710)

**Job Family:** Software

**Req ID:** 530396

**Company Overview**

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments.

• Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.).

• Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking.

• Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices.

• Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production.

• Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards.

**Qualifications**

• 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production.

• Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD).

• Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics.

• Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling).

• Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies.

• Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph.

• Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows.

• Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations.

**Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills**

• Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl.

• Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval.

• Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA).

• Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools.

• Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases).

**Why Us**

We are Siemens:

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

## Job Description

**Overview**

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more [about what we do](https://www.keysight.com/us/en/about.html).

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an [award-winning](https://jobs.keysight.com/awards)[culture](https://jobs.keysight.com/awards).Learn more [about our benefits](https://jobs.keysight.com/benefits).

AI Labs at Keysight builds shared AI building blocks for Keysight's product teams. One of them is an enterprise knowledge and retrieval service: it ingests technical documents, makes them searchable, and gives AI assistants accurate, source-backed answers. You will make retrieval good and dependable: the ingestion pipelines, the search, and the evaluation that proves it works. This is a software engineering role covering services, APIs, data pipelines, quality and scale.

**Responsibilities**

- Build and maintain the ingestion pipeline in Python: document parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, versioning of sources and access control.
- Improve retrieval quality: hybrid (keyword plus vector) search, reranking, query rewriting and metadata filtering, including for technical content such as manuals and reference documents.
- Build evaluation tooling: golden question sets, retrieval and answer-quality metrics, and regression checks in CI.
- Expose retrieval through REST APIs and tool interfaces such as MCP so that AI agents can use it as a tool.
- Run the services in production: tests, observability, latency, and cost-aware use of GPUs and LLM endpoints, including on-premises and air-gapped deployments.
- Support onboarding of product teams and share findings through short write-ups and demos.

**Qualifications**

## Required

- 5 to 8 years of professional Python backend engineering; REST APIs, SQL, async programming.
- Has owned a production service or pipeline end to end, and can guide less experienced engineers.
- Working knowledge of RAG and some hands-on experience: you have built or contributed to a retrieval or LLM-based application (a project, prototype or production feature) and understand chunking, embeddings, vector search and how to judge result quality. A strong backend engineer who has moved into RAG is a good fit; you do not need years of RAG-only experience.
- Experience building document-processing or data-ingestion pipelines.
- Containers and CI/CD; comfortable deploying to Kubernetes.
- Disciplined testing and code review habits.
- Collaborates with colleagues across India, the US and the UK, and communicates clearly in English.

## Preferred

- Production RAG experience: chunking and embedding choices, hybrid search, reranking, and how you measured quality.
- LLM and retrieval evaluation (RAGAS-style or custom); embedding model selection or fine-tuning.
- LLM endpoints (Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, self-hosted models); tool-calling, MCP or agent-framework integrations (a plus, not required).
- Experience with technical documentation or semi-structured content.
- Curiosity about test and measurement or telecom domains.
- Experience using AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) in day-to-day development, with the judgement to review and test what they produce.
